description: Local Mail sends a person to Google's consent screen in their own browser, in the production build. Google refuses custom URI schemes for a Desktop OAuth client, so the consent screen has to open outside this WebView and return to the host's loopback origin; the window's `on_navigation` guard admits only that origin, which is why opening is a native verb rather than a navigation. Scoped to the one authorization endpoint: this grants Local Mail no general power to open links, and the callback comes back through the host rather than through here.
